messages.content:
Summarize in one sentence of at most 160 characters:

The museum will extend weekend hours to 9 p.m. starting June 1 after visitor numbers rose 22% last spring. Admission prices stay unchanged.

reference: The museum extends weekend hours to 9 p.m. from June 1 with unchanged prices after a 22% visitor rise.

messages.content:
Summarize in at most 170 characters:

A data-center fire on Monday took the payment API offline for 3 hours. Engineers restored service from a secondary region. Customers were not double-charged. A postmortem is due Friday.

reference: A Monday data-center fire took the payment API offline for 3 hours; service was restored with no double charges and a postmortem due Friday.
